episode_title: Making the Invisible Visible: Team Utilization Strategy with Michael Daoud of Visus LLC

real_qa.q: How does Visus LLC track team utilization and gather time data across projects?
real_qa.r: Visus LLC uses a PSA platform called Projector where team members log time spent on external or internal projects. With in-house web development and data expertise, they pull data via Projector's API into a custom data warehouse built in SQL Server to analyze utilization, project budgets, and revenue impact.
real_qa.requete: Visus LLC utilization tracking data warehouse

real_qa.q: What impact does displaying real-time utilization metrics to team members have on productivity?
real_qa.r: When Michael's team began sharing daily utilization reports during huddles with visual indicators—green for hitting targets, red for missing them—team members immediately self-corrected without management pressure. People wanted to see green bars and naturally focused on billable work, making the behavior change automatic and sustainable.
real_qa.requete: team utilization dashboard green red targets productivity

real_qa.q: Why is daily time entry critical for project budget management in professional services?
real_qa.r: If time is checked weekly, you review it 52 times per year; monthly means 12 times per year. Daily entry allows over 300 reviews annually (accounting for holidays and vacations), giving project managers real-time visibility to catch budget overruns early and maintain cost control through project completion.
real_qa.requete: daily time tracking budget monitoring professional services

real_qa.q: How does shifting from monthly to weekly utilization reviews improve business decision-making?
real_qa.r: Visus LLC moved from reviewing financial KPIs monthly (12 times yearly) to weekly (52 times yearly) after an unforeseen client project pause revealed the risk of infrequent checks. Monday and Friday huddles now display utilization snapshots that inform Tuesday financial KPI meetings, enabling faster response to revenue and resource changes.
real_qa.requete: weekly utilization review financial KPIs agility

real_qa.q: What role-based utilization targets does Visus LLC apply across different team functions?
real_qa.r: Utilization targets are role-based because administrative work varies by function. Developers with less administrative work can achieve higher utilization targets than project managers, who have greater administrative responsibilities. Targets apply only to client-facing team members across development, testing, and project management roles.
real_qa.requete: role-based utilization targets developer project manager

real_qa.q: How can companies without technical teams start measuring team utilization?
real_qa.r: Start with a basic spreadsheet if technical capability is limited. Most systems have APIs or built-in utilization reports—dig into your existing tools first. If those don't suffice, hire an external company to pull data and build simple reports. The key is accessing data to make better business decisions, regardless of technical sophistication.
real_qa.requete: team utilization spreadsheet simple tools getting started

His company specializes in leveraging internal technical expertise to build custom data solutions, including data warehouses and APIs integrations, to help professional services firms track and optimize team utilization and project profitability.
